intent: Route an incoming support ticket: classify it into a category (billing / technical / sales / other), send the technical and billing categories to a severity probe, stop on the rest, and on the probe score the severity and page on-call when severe, queue today when degraded, otherwise send to backlog.

known_steps.text: a choice question "category" asks "Which team should handle this ticket?"
a score question "severity" asks "How severe is the impact?"
the workflow runs at most 5 iterations

unknown_steps.text: a decision question "category" asks "Which team should handle this ticket?"
a question "category" asks "Which team should handle this ticket?"
assign label "PAGE_ONCALL" when "severity" is at least 1.5
